capture.measured_share: **51.5%** of total serving GPU time in the expert GEMM alone (`fused_moe_kernel`), **64.3%** for the whole MoE dispatch including the per-token FP8 activation quant, SiLU-and-mul, block-size alignment and the weighted sum. Torch-profiler sweep on 8x B300, random 1024/256 at concurrency 16, CUDA graphs on.

environment.gpu: 8x NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC, sm_103, 288 GB/card, single node

benchmark.timing: triton.testing.do_bench around a captured CUDA graph, L2 cold, interleaved A/B

triton_fused_moe_gemm.note: SGLang compares the fused MoE against a torch-naive MoE at 1e-5; the LoRA MoE kernel test uses 1e-2/1e-2 (test_fused_moe_lora_kernel.py:378) for a fused-vs-fused comparison.

moe_fused_experts_fp8.note: SGLang compares the fused MoE against a torch-naive MoE at 1e-5; the LoRA MoE kernel test uses 1e-2/1e-2 (test_fused_moe_lora_kernel.py:378) for a fused-vs-fused comparison.

correctness.policy: rtol/atol are copied from SGLang's own test for each kernel (source cited per op). Do not loosen them in a task; if a tolerance is wrong, fix it upstream and re-copy.
notes: `moe_fused_experts_fp8` runs inplace=True: the returned tensor must alias hidden_states, and the harness restores it between iterations.
